name: 28491-solodecode-gptoss120b-tp4
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b. Public and ungated, 60.8 GiB of safetensors; the checkpoint declares its own quantization (MX-format 4-bit expert weights, bfloat16 activations).
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one a3 node, one allocation.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 60 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 45 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, one turn per request: 1024 prompt tokens in and 1024 output tokens out, no length variance and no shared prefix. Each request carries `min_tokens: 1024` in the body, and guidellm sets `max_completion_tokens` and `ignore_eos` itself, so every request emits exactly 1024 tokens.
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on a 120-billion-parameter model, one request at a time across four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at the commit this item pins. Flat `key: value` only.
model-path: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tp-size: 4
